description: This PHP class 'DataGroup' defines a data transfer object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM installation utility. It encapsulates information about a data group, including its name, description, allowed permissions, and a list of permissions, and provides methods for instantiation and data access.

classes.name: DataGroup
classes.description: A DTO representing a data group with associated permissions for use during the installation process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing DataGroup with name, description, allowed permission, and permissions list.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DataGroup instance from a given name and array data defining the group's properties.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data group.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the data group.

methods.name: getAllowed
methods.description: Returns the AllowedPermission object associated with the data group.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of DataGroupPermission objects associated with the data group.
